title: General Bacterial Spot (Xanthomonas spp.) Management Advisory
content:
General disease-level advisory — verify local label restrictions before chemical application.

Disease Category: Bacterial Spot / Canker / Blight (Xanthomonas spp.)
Application Scope: Multi-Crop Horticultural & Agronomic Plants
Authoritative Source: ICAR Integrated Pest Management (IPM) Guidelines / SAU Extension
Official Bulletin: https://icar.org.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: General Disease-Level Recommendation

1. General Identification:
• Small angular water-soaked lesions that turn necrotic, brown, or purplish, often surrounded by chlorotic halos; centers may drop out forming shot-holes.
• Cankers on tender shoots and scabby lesions on fruits.

2. Immediate Cultural Precautions:
• Avoid sprinkler or overhead splash irrigation that disseminates bacterial cells.
• Maximize canopy aeration and sunlight through selective pruning.
• Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizers that stimulate soft, succulent tissue.

3. Sanitation:
• Collect, bury, or burn all diseased plant debris and fallen leaves.
• Disinfect cutting and pruning tools with 70% ethyl alcohol between cuts.

4. Non-Chemical Practices:
• Apply approved bio-agents like Bacillus subtilis or Pseudomonas fluorescens at early leaf stages.
• Use certified disease-free seeds or hot water treated planting material.

5. Chemical Guidance (Label Verification Required):
• Chemical treatment is not specified in the verified source for this specific host crop. Prioritize sanitation and cultural methods.
• Where explicitly registered by CIBRC for the target crop, copper-based bactericides (such as Copper Oxychloride 50% WP) or agricultural streptomycin formulations may be evaluated under local agricultural extension supervision.
• Always verify local label registrations, crop safety tolerances, and Pre-Harvest Intervals (PHI) before application.

सामान्य रोग-स्तरीय परामर्श — रासायनिक छिड़काव से पूर्व स्थानीय लेबल व अनुमोदन का सत्यापन करें।

रोग वर्ग: जीवाणु पत्ती धब्बा / कैंकर (Xanthomonas spp.)
प्रामाणिक स्रोत: ICAR राष्ट्रीय एकीकृत कीट प्रबंधन (IPM) दिशानिर्देश
आधिकारिक पोर्टल: https://icar.org.in
परामर्श स्तर: सामान्य रोग-स्तरीय सिफारिश (Tier 2)

1. सामान्य सावधानियां:
• फव्वारा सिंचाई से बचें जिससे जीवाणु का फैलाव न हो; थाला या ड्रिप सिंचाई अपनाएं।
• छंटाई के औजारों को 70% अल्कोहल से विसंक्रमित करें।
• संक्रमित पत्तियों एवं टहनियों को काटकर नष्ट करें।

2. रासायनिक मार्गदर्शन:
• इस विशिष्ट फसल के लिए रासायनिक उपचार सत्यापित स्रोत में निर्दिष्ट नहीं है। सांस्कृतिक स्वच्छता को प्राथमिकता दें। किसी भी छिड़काव से पहले स्थानीय कृषि विज्ञान केंद्र (KVK) से संपर्क करें।

title: General Fungal Leaf Blight Management Advisory
content:
General disease-level advisory — verify local label restrictions before chemical application.

Disease Category: Fungal Foliar Blights (Alternaria / Phytophthora / Cercospora spp.)
Application Scope: Multi-Crop Agricultural Plants
Authoritative Source: ICAR National IPM Guidelines
Official Bulletin: https://icar.org.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: General Disease-Level Recommendation

1. General Symptoms:
• Expanding brown, tan, or dark necrotic spots, concentric rings, or water-soaked lesions causing premature leaf drying and drop.

2. Immediate Cultural & Sanitation:
• Remove and burn severely diseased lower foliage to reduce spore load.
• Stake or trellis crops where appropriate; avoid foliage-wetting irrigation.
• Practice multi-year crop rotation with non-host botanical families.

3. Chemical Guidance:
• Chemical treatment is not specified in the verified source for this specific host crop. Prioritize sanitation and cultural methods.
• Prophylactic protectant fungicides (e.g. Mancozeb, Copper Oxychloride) are widely registered for blight across many crops, but exact dosage and PHI must be verified from the official CIBRC label for your specific crop.

title: General Plant Rust Management Advisory
content:
General disease-level advisory — verify local label restrictions before chemical application.

Disease Category: Rust Fungi (Puccinia / Uromyces spp.)
Application Scope: Multi-Crop Agricultural Plants
Authoritative Source: ICAR National IPM Guidelines
Official Bulletin: https://icar.org.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: General Disease-Level Recommendation

1. General Symptoms:
• Powdery cinnamon, reddish-brown, or yellow pustules rupturing on leaf surfaces.

2. Management:
• Cultural: Plant rust-resistant cultivars; maintain balanced potassium fertilization.
• Sanitation: Deep summer ploughing to bury overwintering teliospores; eradicate alternate weed hosts.
• Chemical Guidance: Chemical treatment is not specified in the verified source for this crop. Prioritize sanitation and cultural methods; verify CIBRC approved label recommendations locally.
